body:
### Place order ignores live token shortfall

**Medium Severity**

While the pay-token balance is unresolved, `effectiveAvailableBalance` falls through to the Perps balance, so `usePerpsOrderValidation` can report `isValid` for the wrong source. After the token resolves as too small, `isPayBalanceLoading` drops immediately, but validation stays debounced and the Place Order `isDisabled` list never consults `hasInsufficientPayTokenBalance`, so the button can enable for a trade the live token cannot fund.

Locations:
app/components/UI/Perps/Views/PerpsOrderView/PerpsOrderView.tsx#L2256-L2265
app/components/UI/Perps/Views/PerpsOrderView/PerpsOrderView.tsx#L2490-L2496
app/components/UI/Perps/hooks/usePerpsOrderValidation.ts#L236-L244
action: Added hasInsufficientPayTokenBalance to both Place Order isDisabled lists so the button cannot enable during the 300 ms (PERFORMANCE_CONFIG.ValidationDebounceMs) window where validation still carries the verdict it reached against the Perps balance; the first half of the claim (unresolved balance) was already covered by isPayBalanceLoading.
